title: flextime: filterbank learning to explain time series
core_idea: Replace instance-wise time-domain saliency masks with a learnable bank of bandpass filters that decomposes a time series into interpretable frequency bands, and learn combinations of those bands as saliency maps to explain a model's prediction.
tldr: Explain time series predictions by learning saliency over interpretable frequency-band components using a trainable filterbank rather than time-domain masks, enabling clearer explanations for complex signals like EEG and audio.
